Many tigers in captivity enjoy snow— not just Siberian tigers! Did you know the difference between all these tiger terms?! ❄️🐅 #tigers #amurtiger #bengaltiger #siberiantiger  Another thing to note: Siberian tigers are now referred to as Amur tigers! Amur tigers are the only tiger population native to cold, harsh environments. Because we see many comments referring to “Siberian” tigers, that was used for the sake of the video. 🎥🐾

We had many people in our comments who assumed we were just random people who bought a tiger cub and many people asking where they can get a tiger. We want to address this because it’s very important. Rick is not just a normal person with a tiger. Rick owns a USDA licensed zoo and Mowgli is not a personal pet. Mowgli came from another zoo and was not purchased as a pet. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! We will NEVER have tiger encounters available and no visitors will ever be allowed to touch him or interact with him. When he is older and cleared to go outside you can see him in his enclosure if you visit the zoo. We hope that clears a few things up!

Everywhere you look, everywhere you go… there’s a tiger! Welcome to Tiger House, where the newest residents have officially gotten their names. We'd like to formally introduce you to Boneka (Bo-nae-ka) and Kari (Kuh-dee)! As Sumatran tigers, these girls have a special connection to Indonesia. Sumatra is a large island in Indonesia and the only place where Sumatran tigers are found in the wild. Their Indonesian names were chosen as an ode to their cultural heritage. Boneka, the Indonesian word for doll, was chosen in honor of Dolly Parton and Kari, the Indonesian word for curry, was chosen in honor of Tim Curry. These two little ladies are growing up fast, and before long, they’ll be ready to meet all of you. Until then, we’ll be bringing you along for all the tiny paws, big personalities and adorable milestones right here on social media.
